board.description: Task board directory, relative to the project root. One file per task.

defaultFlow.description: small: dispatcher -> coder -> QA. big: + architect before coders, reviewer after QA.

dispatcherModel.description: Model for the main (dispatcher) session, as provider/modelId from `pi --list-models`.

fixBudget.description: Shared QA + reviewer rejection rounds before a task stops and escalates.

enabled.description: false: this project never dispatches this role; the pipeline skips it.

maxTurns.description: Turn ceiling for one dispatch of this role.

model.description: provider/modelId from `pi --list-models`. Must be exact; RPC model resolution is fuzzy.

prompt.description: Full replacement for the role's default prompt. Empty means use the default.

promptAppend.description: Text appended to the role's default prompt. Ignored when prompt is set.

skills.description: Skill names preloaded into the role's system prompt (the skills: frontmatter line).

thinking.description: Thinking level for this role, clamped to what the model supports.

tools.description: Tool allowlist for the role (the tools: frontmatter line).

roles.description: Per-role overrides. A role not listed here uses the package default.

label.description: Task-file label that triggers the security auditor when trigger is label.

trigger.description: label: only tasks marked security-sensitive. always/never: every task / no task.

subagents.description: Subagent backend: herbertgao (@herbertgao/pi-subagents, RPC v2) or official (pi-subagents, RPC v1). Must match the package installed in this project.
